title: Temple of Kalabsha

buildingCutout.basis: Only actual principal temple polygon0;independent island monuments1..4 remain native. No arbitrary bounding-box replacement.

note: Complete current principal temple exterior:two battered broken-top pylon towers and physically open central portal,raised approach/steps,open stone forecourt and three-sided surviving colonnade,high four-column hypostyle screen/open passage and roofless hall,distinct rear vestibule/sanctuary roofs/chambers,lower irregular surrounding enclosure and side postern. Separate nearby Kertassi,Beit el-Wali and other island monuments are excluded and remain native map buildings. No native internal footprints/heights. Pylon15.5m,hall13m,rear roofs10.8m and all columns/doors/screens/broken courses are original photo-proportional approximations scaled to the retained76.511x34.309m footprint,not a surveyed restoration. Exact sculpted reliefs/inscriptions and unobserved inner chambers are excluded. +X ESE toward the lake-facing pylon/entrance,-X WNW toward the rear sanctuary;+Z SSW toward the lakeside flank,-Z NNE toward the island interior;+Y up.
